title: On the maximal measure of a spherical set avoiding solutions to x + y + z = 0
summary: We prove that the maximal normalized surface measure of a spherical set in d dimensions avoiding solutions to x + y + z = 0 approaches 1/2 as d goes to infinity. This gives a partial answer to a question of Bukh, who conjectured 1/2 to be the optimal bound for all d >= 3.
